Here are 5 places to see in Jaipur, in a sensible order: start at Amber Fort in the morning, then work your way into the old city. The old-city stops (Hawa Mahal, City Palace and Jantar Mantar) are all a short walk apart. The positions are approximate.

Amber Fort
Hilltop fort with palace courtyards. Go early to beat the crowds.
2
Jal Mahal
Palace in the middle of Man Sagar Lake. Best for a photo stop.
3
Hawa Mahal
The pink 'Palace of Winds' with its honeycomb windows.
4
City Palace
Royal residence with museums and courtyards.
5
Jantar Mantar
18th-century observatory with giant stone instruments.

India's real GDP growth went from -5.8% in FY21 to 9.7% in FY22, then 7.6%, 9.2% and 6.5% in FY25. The FY21 dip was the Covid year, and the later numbers are the rebound and then a gradual cooling. These are from memory of the official revised figures, so they may be slightly off. I can't check live data from here, and the latest year may have been revised again.
